sources.title: Canopy README.md
sources.locator: Workflow; highlights; release/platform table; privacy; support
sources.finding: Documents Tauri desktop, CLI integrations and local-first operation; explicitly warns main may be newer than released packages. README says no telemetry and Windows installer unsigned, which conflict with current source/release disclosures.

sources.title: Canopy LICENSE.md
sources.finding: MIT covers public source; bundled dependencies have separate notices.

sources.title: Canopy docs/egm-spec-stage.md
sources.finding: Design proposes spec drafting and sequential fresh reviewers; source now implements workflow factory. Shell-write gating is explicitly out of the proposal scope.

sources.title: Canopy src-tauri/src/agent_cli.rs
sources.finding: Ten named CLI integrations include Claude/Codex/Amp/Aider/Antigravity/OpenCode/OMP/Cursor/Grok/Kiro. Profile isolation and account probes differ; only four CLI entries expose profile isolation.

sources.title: Canopy src-tauri/src/tasks.rs
sources.finding: SQLite-backed task envelopes retain goal/acceptance, stable run and attempt IDs, route/authority/failover policy, deadlines, transcript/events/artifacts and metadata. These are run records, not a full issue CRUD hierarchy.

sources.title: Canopy src/workflowExecutor.ts
sources.finding: Executor reserves durable tasks/attempts, advances conditional bounded-loop edges, exposes human decision cards and waits, and uses explicit verdict files rather than guessed success.

sources.title: Canopy src/workflowDefinition.ts
sources.finding: Validated workflow events include issues, PRs, tasks, Git, agents, research, servers and mesh. Manual and event triggers are explicit; catalog has no cron trigger.

sources.title: Canopy src/egm/egmWorkflow.ts
sources.finding: Built-in spec workflow installs pinned EGM persona/standard files without overwriting local edits; fresh read-only-review steps produce severity-labelled reports and bounded review loops.

sources.title: Canopy src/plans/planGate.ts
sources.finding: Plans carry decisions/acceptance and persist launch specs for restart. Planning can be skipped and failure/no brain starts work without a plan; it is not a mandatory universal gate.

sources.title: Canopy src-tauri/src/ledger.rs
sources.locator: LedgerEntry; KINDS; append; query; status supersession
sources.finding: Local per-repository JSONL ledger records plan/receipt/handoff/rule/spend/review/outcome with author and scope. Supersession retains history; this is owner-writable storage, not an external immutable audit service.

sources.title: Canopy src/trackers.ts
sources.finding: GitHub via gh and Linear via locally stored key are the concrete issue providers. External ticket identity links branches and dispatch; fetches are deduplicated.

sources.title: Canopy src-tauri/src/git.rs
sources.locator: gh_pr_merge; gh_pr_review_batch; gh_issue_*; linear_issue_*; worktree helpers
sources.finding: Native code handles branch/worktree/diff/PR operations, GitHub review and issue comments/state, Linear comments/state. Merge calls gh by PR number/method without an expected-head SHA in this command.

sources.title: Canopy src/agentTools.ts
sources.locator: tool group descriptors and native canopy_hook dispatch contract
sources.finding: Exposes task/name/status, scoped workspace/LSP/preview tools, advisory path claims, visible child spawn, messages, mesh, machine and question tools. Descriptors are cross-checked against sidecar dispatcher before claiming access.

sources.title: Canopy src/agentHierarchy.ts
sources.finding: Parent PTY IDs link delegated visible tabs; closed-parent orphans become roots and cycles are cut. This is session lineage, not an epic issue graph.

sources.title: Canopy src-tauri/src/mcp.rs
sources.finding: Discovers multiple CLI MCP stores, redacts credential values from webview summaries and retains non-serializable native launch specs.

sources.title: Canopy src-tauri/src/mcp_client.rs
sources.locator: connect/discover tools and stdio/HTTP connection code
sources.finding: Public Rust implementation supplies MCP transport/client operations; external servers retain their own permission/service semantics.

sources.title: Canopy src-tauri/src/portal.rs
sources.finding: Optional phone/browser portal has PIN/session capability admission and explicit enable/disable; admitted sessions last for server lifetime rather than a wall-clock expiry. Host must stay available.

sources.title: Canopy src-tauri/src/remote/mod.rs
sources.finding: Explicit read/interact capability ladder permits named commands and limits file access to registered workspace scope; unknown commands are not dispatchable.

sources.title: Canopy src-tauri/src/relay.rs
sources.locator: new_code; Member; CollabBody; secure handshake/frame paths
sources.finding: LAN relay uses OS-random join codes, SPAKE2 handshake, authenticated encrypted frames and Ed25519/TOFU member identities. Collaborative file owner remains authority over revisions/disk writes; this is not an enterprise identity proof.

sources.title: Canopy packages/control-plane/lib/team-policy.mjs
sources.finding: Public account-control code defines owner/admin/member/viewer permissions and project/Git/agent/session sharing switches. Credentials are not shared merely because membership exists.

sources.title: Canopy packages/control-plane/lib/lifecycle.mjs
sources.finding: Managed lifecycle phases distinguish hibernate with retained storage from deletion including storage/backups; operations are authorized/idempotent and guarded against concurrent transitions. Deployed private configuration is not established.

sources.title: Canopy packages/control-plane/lib/credit-purchase.mjs
sources.finding: Source implements USD credit purchase limits5–500 and presets10/25/50/100 with signed Stripe-event crediting. Presets are deposits, not monthly compute prices; deployment can disable purchases.

sources.title: Canopy packages/control-plane/lib/credit-enforcement.mjs
sources.finding: In enforce mode exhausted-credit cutoff can request permanent workspace/storage/backups deletion; notify/off modes differ. This is code policy, not verified deployed mode or retention promise.

sources.title: Canopy src/placement/balancer.ts
sources.locator: choosePlacement; effectivePreference; explicit-target and automatic fallback branches
sources.finding: Chooses online capacity/low utilization among connected targets. Explicit full target or automatic all-full may launch locally with warning; this is not a hard global concurrency limit.

sources.title: Canopy src-tauri/src/containment.rs
sources.finding: Conditional Linux delegated cgroup memory.high and Windows Job Object notification thresholds report capability only after verification; macOS/unavailable paths monitor only. No hard memory/OOM quota or hostile-code sandbox is claimed.

sources.title: Canopy src/outcomes/budgets.ts
sources.finding: Session/plan/default budgets warn at80% and send Esc once per turn at100% when terminal known; otherwise notify. Poll45seconds and estimated spend imply possible overshoot, not billed-dollar hard cap.

sources.title: Canopy src/pricing.ts
sources.finding: Model-family list-price estimates use approximate cache multipliers; CLI reported cost wins. Unknown/unpriced model yields null. Provider bills/subscription allowance are not reconciled.

sources.title: Canopy src-tauri/src/gates.rs
sources.locator: Gate DSL; Policy; APPROVAL_TTL_MS; policy evaluation
sources.finding: User-approved rules compile into deterministic hook policy; dangerous command tokens expire after10minutes and bind command. Egress filtering is best effort, not OS network isolation.

sources.title: Canopy src-tauri/src/vault.rs
sources.finding: Browser credentials are encrypted in local vault.enc with Argon2id/XChaCha20-Poly1305; readable defaults false, domain approval controls fill/read, idle key auto-lock30minutes. External CLI account stores are separate.

sources.title: Canopy src-tauri/src/session_transfer.rs
sources.finding: Copies supported backend conversation between account profiles without copying credentials; checks source stability and refuses diverging destination. Agent restart/resume is not process migration.

sources.title: Canopy src-tauri/src/spot.rs
sources.finding: SQLite FTS indexes saved transcripts and bounded live scrollback; incremental ingestion, deletion/staleness purge and rebuild keep derived search local. No empirical retrieval accuracy claim.

sources.title: Canopy src/prReview.ts
sources.finding: PR review UI derives unresolved actionable comments and trusted-author instructions, groups by file and refreshes live state. This does not alone establish exact-revision approval.

sources.title: Canopy src-tauri/src/crash.rs
sources.locator: CRASH_ENDPOINT; post_report; pending file; GitHub issue path
sources.finding: Rust sends message/stack/version/OS/arch/timestamp to canopyide.dev/api/crash on frontend request; native panic parks local pending file. Public GitHub report path previews attribution and redacts home path.
